title: Validated Expense Ledger and Net Balances
instructions: Implement the validation in `Expense` and `ExpenseUser` plus `net_balances`, `record_settlement` and `expenses_for_user` in `ledger.py`. Money is integer minor units, the dataclasses are frozen, and an expense that breaks the paid-equals-owed rule must be impossible to construct.

evidence.label: Computes net balance (paid minus owed) per user for one expense
Omits users whose net balance is exactly zero
Aggregates many expenses and the balances sum to zero
Rejects an expense where paid does not equal owed
Requires at least one PAID and one HAD_TO_PAY row
Rejects zero, negative, float and boolean amounts
A settlement is a PAYMENT expense that reduces the debt
A PAYMENT needs one payer and one receiver who differ
Lists only the user's expenses, sorted by id
